name: Pain
doc: Pain (spell; the act family, Drain's master without actor pools or stage tasks): one emitter per action - its sound, two prim-model players on the target (a glow and the model), the master's release, the damage. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag034_pain.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its tasks the port's, its parts spawned by them): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: Drain's master in the act family's form: once its children are gone

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: its sound, the two model players on the target, the master's release, the damage

params.label: Release tick
params.doc: The master may start the next action at this tick

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage of its target from this tick

tasks.doc: One per action: the module's own emitter (the port's task): its sound, the two model players, the master's release, the damage.
